title: The yen surges and Japanese consumption falls 3.6% in July while the Tokyo stock market rebounds
summary: The Japanese currency appreciates on bets of rate hikes, real spending chains eight months of declines and the Nikkei rises supported by the drop in U.S. yields.

title: Tesla unveils its Cybercab robotaxi without steering wheel or pedals and begins tests in Austin
summary: The autonomous vehicle is shown to the public and begins supervised rides, prompting an evaluation by the U.S. road safety agency.
